newsitem.title: GERMANY: German IBIS to return to normal hours next week.
newsitem.headline: German IBIS to return to normal hours next week.

text.p: The Frankfurt stock exchange said on Thursday that IBIS computerised dealings would return to normal trading hours next week.
"IBIS trade will no longer be extended next week," a spokesman for the bourse told Reuters.
Electronic trading had been extended by two hours from 1600 GMT to 1800 GMT, to accomodate heavy volume trading in newly-floated telecommunications giant Deutsche Telekom.
The exchange also said the minimum block of Telekom shares that could be traded on the IBIS system would be reduced to 500 shares from the 5,000 share minimum in force this week.
